rock-church-virginia-beach.assessment: Rock Church International is one of Hampton Roads' most historic megachurches — founded in 1968 by Bishops John and Anne Gimenez as a Pentecostal congregation with national impact. The church hosted major Washington For Jesus rallies in the 1980s and 1990s drawing hundreds of thousands to DC. Today, Senior Pastors John and Robin Blanchard lead the congregation. The primary concern for complementarian men: Robin Blanchard serves as a co-Senior Pastor, and the church's history includes female episcopal leadership (Bishop Anne Gimenez). For men committed to biblical male-only eldership/pastoral leadership, this is a disqualifying red flag. The church's charismatic heritage and Pentecostal theology require evaluation for those outside that tradition. Rock Church has genuine gospel impact and community roots, but the gender/leadership structure places it outside clear biblical complementarianism.

score_notes.christology: Rock Church holds orthodox Trinitarian Christology and affirms Jesus as Lord and Savior. Green.
score_notes.scripture: Pentecostal tradition emphasizes experiential encounter; inerrancy may be affirmed but experience often shapes hermeneutics in charismatic contexts.
score_notes.gender: RED VALIDATED — Live fetch confirms Robin Blanchard (female) serves jointly as Senior Pastor with husband John Blanchard. Purpose statement attributed to both jointly. Female senior pastoral authority contradicts 1 Tim 2:12 and complementarian standard.
score_notes.leadership: Husband-wife co-pastor model confirmed live. Legacy of matriarchal leadership (Gimenez era) documented in charismatic/apostolic governance.
score_notes.soteriology: Pentecostal tradition affirms grace through faith. Charismatic emphasis on ongoing Spirit gifts is present.
score_notes.cultural: Rock Church has deep Hampton Roads roots and community involvement. Historical Washington For Jesus rallies show patriotic evangelical identity. Generally conservative.
score_notes.preaching: Pentecostal/charismatic preaching style. Emphasis on healing, deliverance, and Spirit empowerment.
score_notes.mission: Rock Church International has a strong global missions footprint — planted 400+ churches worldwide under founding leadership.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's ministry exists but church culture is shaped by charismatic expression.
score_notes.denominational: Rock Ministerial Fellowship (RMF) — a self-contained apostolic/prophetic network. Limited external accountability.

royal-lane-baptist-sbc-dallas-tx.assessment: Royal Lane Baptist Church called Rev. Victoria Robb Powers as Senior Pastor in November 2022, making her the first female senior pastor of any Baptist church in the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex. The congregation is fully LGBTQIA+ welcoming and affirming, was previously declared out of fellowship with the Dallas Baptist Association over ordaining a practicing-homosexual deacon, and aligns with CBF and the Alliance of Baptists. Powers's role as preaching senior pastor places the church in direct conflict with BF&M 2000 Article VI.
